verdict.rationale: Bulk or batch operations, such as batch inference or transcription across many inputs, are a fair axis for an AI SDK and CLI. However, the evidence pack documents only single-item calls (generate, transcribe, synthesize, vlm, images). The multi-file fields in DownloadProgress (currentFileIndex, totalFiles) describe one model download made of several files, which is an adjacent behavior and not a user-facing bulk operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
